The Above Premiere Nashville is complete with all the amenities you need, located a block away from 12 South and just minutes from downtown. This property is a favorite for our luxury customers.

The space
...destinations come alive and assist with any pre-arrival needs for your group.

* House Manager service- At check-in, you will be introduced to your personal House Manager, who is carefully selected and trained in the art of service. Our House Managers visit daily, and our managers are available 24/7 to deliver that ABOVE 5-star experience.

* We will also delight you with the ABOVE Welcome Experience, daily refresh service, luxury spa amenities, luxury white linens, and more!

* Curated Residences - Guests trusting ABOVE for their luxury travel learn that the unexpected is our standard. Most of our estates are the homeowner's primary residences- contrary to an industry filled with contrived, sparsely appointed investment rental properties. Our luxury properties immerse guests in the finest of amenities, finishes, and concierge services while giving visitors the true sense of living like a local.

Nestled in the sought-after 12 South neighborhood, the Above Premiere Nashville Estate is tucked away in one of the most social areas in Nashville. If you are looking for a special night out, this estate is within walking distance of some of Nashville's best restaurants, like the award-winning 12 South Taproom and Grill, Bartaco, Urban Grub, and Josephine. 
As you enter through the front door, you will be greeted by a sitting room with one-of-a-kind artwork. The open kitchen and living room design create the perfect atmosphere for a dinner party. You will find the Primary bedroom on the main floor, which gives a great view of the backyard and pool. As you head upstairs, there are an additional 4 bedrooms, each with private baths and a game room.  Continuing to the basement, you will find a workout room, theater, and a full bath. This home also comes complete with an elevator! 

The home is pre-set for ten guests. Upon approval, we will set the home for up to twelve guests using luxury Frontgate bed-height air mattress beds with foam toppers (upon request).  A large group fee may apply.  

DISCLAIMER: Room configurations, bedding, decor, and all other contents depicted in the photos may have changed since being photographed.

*All bookings with ABOVE must be pre-approved before they are considered confirmed. The ease of "click to book" with our travel partners should be viewed as "click to request." Only through proper vetting can we ensure the homeowner's needs and our guest's expectations are in sync before we can confirm any reservation. *

IMPORTANT: Our properties will not be rented to any group/event that may disrupt the serene neighborhood. We deeply value our neighbors; thus, final approval of any reservation only comes after a conversation that gives us full confidence that neighbor rights and house rules will be respected. NO DISRUPTIVE GUESTS.

ABOVE Vacation Residences 
 
Who We Are.

Over the years, ABOVE has quietly become the go to leader for connecting the most discerning guests, with private luxury properties. Founded on the promise of exclusivity and complete privacy, ABOVE manages only the country’s finest and most exclusive homes and estates available for lease.  

ABOVE’s concept and unique approach to home and estate rentals can only be found in the management of the world's pinnacle and iconic hotels.  Our process is designed to match the most discerning guests, with the appropriate homeowners, whilst delighting both through our unique and proprietary experiences.

How We Are Different.

Each home represented can only be approved by our Standards Selection Board, in turn most home applications received are not able to join ABOVE. This intense, 250-point process insures our homes meet ABOVE’s strict and uncompromising luxury standards.  This impartial, standards driven, demanding process separates ABOVE from the all vacation rental companies today.  Tight and uncompromising controls gives our guests the quality, confidence, and comfort they require.  

Formed by three luxury hospitality veterans, and guided by a private 5-Diamond hotel company, ABOVE’s guests and owners appreciate the uncommonly high level of standardization of amenities, concierge and travel services, event planning, and that true attention missing in today's vacation property experiences.

If you and your group are looking for an exceptional level of quality and experience in a vacation rental, we invite you to visit our signature homes. 

If you are an owner of a unique and one-of-a-kind property that would like to apply to the ABOVE portfolio, please reach out to us. 

We would love to hear from you.
